finding: A maintainer can see setup retarget a symlink to a backup copy of an orientation file. All three handbook rows promise to keep any symlink whose target falls outside the Factory orientation files. In init-factory, _is_factory_orientation_link tests the resolved path with a string prefix, so a sibling such as .agent-factory/factory/config-backup/AGENTS.md also qualifies. In a scratch project, _link_orientation retargeted all four CLI links from that backup to config/AGENTS.md. In the three handbook rows, tie retargeting to the links the installer recognizes and mention that the check uses a path prefix and accepts legacy targets.
why_this_severity: The inventory still lists the orientation paths and their ignore rules (no to fails_purpose). A maintainer must consult the installer to explain the retargeted link.
